doctors.title: Our Doctors
doctors.description: At Cure Digital Clinic, we are committed to providing high-quality healthcare through a team of licensed and qualified doctors.

q1.question: What is Cure Digital Clinic?
q1.answer: Cure Digital Clinic is a licensed telemedicine clinic that connects you with doctors online. Its mission is to make healthcare more accessible, flexible, and reliable from the comfort of your home.

q2.question: What specializations are currently available?
q2.answer: Current specializations include: Internal Medicine, Family Medicine, Geriatrics, and Palliative Care. Coming soon: Endocrinology, Gastroenterology, Rheumatology, Oncology, Nephrology, Urology, Cardiology, Psychiatry, Pediatrics, Obstetrics & Gynecology, ENT, and General Surgery.

q3.question: How do I book a digital appointment?

list.3: Select a suitable time and confirm your booking.

q3.hint: You will receive a confirmation message with your appointment details.

q4.question: How do I prepare for my online appointment?

list.1: Make sure your phone or computer is charged.
list.2: Prepare your medical history, medications, and test results.
list.3: Choose a quiet and well-lit place for your consultation.

q5.question: Can I get prescriptions through Cure Digital Clinic?
q5.answer: Yes, after the consultation, the doctor can issue an electronic prescription that you can fill at your nearest pharmacy.

q6.question: Are my medical records secure?
q6.answer: Absolutely. Your data is encrypted and securely stored according to Saudi Ministry of Health regulations and standards. Privacy and confidentiality are our top priorities.

q8.question: Can elderly people use the digital clinic?
q8.answer: Yes, Cure Digital Clinic is specifically designed to meet the needs of older adults. Our geriatric and palliative care doctors are trained to provide personalized and compassionate care.

q9.question: What if I need emergency care?
q9.answer: Cure Digital Clinic is not intended for emergencies. If you experience severe chest pain, difficulty breathing, heavy bleeding, or any life-threatening symptoms, please contact emergency services immediately.

q10.question: How much does a consultation cost?
q10.answer: Our consultation fees are affordable and displayed before booking confirmation. Packages and follow-up services are also available.
